name: 🌊Dam Tycoon🌊
desc:
Welcome to Dam Tycoon! 🌊

Build a Dam 🧱 and explore a big map 🌍. Improve you structure 🔨 to generate money 💰, Purchase generators, turbines, machines for water treatment, power lines, play with the force of water 💧.

Open or Close the dam to make you tycoon work 🔩⚙ and watch the smooth water flowing through the terrain ⛺. Advance in you business to unlock new places 🧭.

Use the gears from you inventory that you bought from the roblox Marketplace with complete freedom to fight other players 🔪, get powers 🔥, transport... .

Buy you own House 🏡 and roleplay 😜

💾 Tycoon Auto Save 💾
This tycoon does not have robux buttons! 🚫

This game allows the use of gears
Heavy game for mobile ❗

PM me for any suggestion, ideas ...
